about:
Evergreen Plastic Container Inc. (EPC) operates from Vancouver, Washington, where it manufactures PET plastic containers for food and beverage markets. The company provides full-service packaging solutions that span product design, engineering, and ongoing support.

EPC produces PET bottles, preforms, closures, and custom blow molds, offering both short-run and long-run production. Its capabilities include prototype design and development, color printing for decoration, and a full-service integrated operation that handles the entire production process. The company maintains a warehouse in Vancouver stocking standard components, and partners with other suppliers to fulfill broader packaging needs.

The company serves food and beverage manufacturers seeking rigid PET containers that preserve freshness with top and side seals. Customers range from businesses needing stock bottles to those requiring unique custom shapes, with EPC converting conceptual ideas to mass production in a few weeks.

EPC positions itself as a "One Stop Packaging Center," emphasizing individual service for each client and the ability to manage the complete packaging lifecycle from design through delivery. The firm highlights its in-house tooling, rapid prototype turnaround, and color printing as key differentiators.
